name: Kocchi Muite Shinpu-sama
source:
Vampire Dominanta came to play in the human world. He couldn't go back to the original world for some reason! He visited the church in search of a place to sleep, fell in love with the priest he met there, and attacked him, but he didn't seem to notice such a favor at all...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22338]Freem![/url]]
translation:
吸血鬼统治者来到人类世界玩耍。因为某种原因，他无法回到原来的世界！他来到教堂寻找睡觉的地方，爱上了在那里遇到的牧师，并袭击了他，但他似乎根本没有注意到这样的恩惠……？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22338]Freem![/url]]
